name: Kevin O'Reilly
psychographics: Pragmatic to a fault; believes if it works, don't fix it; avoids apps if a spreadsheet will do.
current_solutions: Shared Excel spreadsheet for extracurricular schedules; physical wall calendar in kitchen; Eir grid broadband.
frustration: Had to drive to the school to pick up a sick kid at 2:30 PM because the school's SMS alert system failed to send the 'early pick-up' notification, leaving me stuck in traffic for 45 minutes.
decision_style: Buys the first thing that fits the spec; never browses alternatives once a decision is made.
voice: Formal and measured; uses full sentences, avoids slang, speaks with a steady Dublin accent cadence.
